findings.title: Checker still authorizes semantic governance and secret violations

location.symbol: Automated checks and deterministic checker contract

findings.observation: The checker still uses token presence, narrow regexes, partial file lists or first-match parsing for exact ownership, secret, ledger, required-content, link, initialization and structured-record gates.
findings.trigger: Invalid content preserves recognized tokens or the first recognized table while changing owners, quoting a secret, adding a competing ledger, leaving required content empty, adding malformed or duplicate structures, or fabricating cleared initial history.
findings.impact: The checker returns exit 0, overall PASS, all 13 checks PASS and a valid digest for content that violates governance and security contracts, allowing false merge authorization and possible credential disclosure or wrong-authority plan execution.

evidence.description: PM-REQ-008 through PM-REQ-017, PM-AC-001 and PM-AC-006 through PM-AC-011, design sections 7 and 11, and implementation-plan lines 245-307 define the missing semantic gates.

A primary five-fixture suite demonstrated malformed acceptance-row, duplicate trace-block, removed non-strict-plan rejection-boundary, code-fence-hidden section and extra tracked-scope false PASS cases.

An independent nine-fixture suite demonstrated wrong REQ/AC owners, comment-only trace, backticked secret, alternate ledger, empty required content, omitted source-link validation and fabricated initial-staleness false PASS cases.
The supplied 22-case harness closes the prior findings but contains none of the new discriminating semantic cases.

findings.remediation: Use structured cardinality-aware parsing; compare exact approved REQ/Slice and AC ownership; reject malformed/duplicate rows, tables, marker blocks and ledgers; enforce unique ordered non-empty sections and every summary field; validate all declared approved/source links; require empty initial histories; enforce the Review-rejection boundary for every plan; and detect quoted/backticked secret assignments without echoing values. Add every reproduced class to the deterministic harness.
findings.verification: The exact live head retains byte-stable 13/13 PASS output; every enumerated fixture exits 1 with overall FAIL and the intended check without printing secret contents; the expanded suite reproduces byte-for-byte; and the refreshed PR envelope binds all updated digests before lifecycle re-review.
